scope: Current HEAD ancestry; author/committer date range 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-17. Not all remote branches or all PRs.
warning: Subject matches are not unique bugs; timestamps and commit count do not measure engineering hours or PR lead time.

intentional.decision: One world, one clock, one committed-event authority; domain reducers do not advance time.
Preserve legacy game-step and older saves while migrating the Gospel profile.
Cancellation grants and per-barrier captured job sets are authority boundaries, not retry policy.
Physical receipts determine task/commitment completion; model output is only a proposal.

reworkFamilies.pattern: Separate projections became stronger claims than the actual authority: task done vs commitment active, resource/goal receipt mismatch, model-selected action vs original physical location/time.
reworkFamilies.prevention: One action contract carries task instance, actor, revision, authorized scope, resource, location, work interval and committed receipt. Add causal story invariants, not only field-shape validators.

reworkFamilies.pattern: A global actor generation was reused to reason about several overlapping queues/barriers; a later save could change ownership of an earlier captured set.
reworkFamilies.prevention: Record immutable capture ownership and explicit cancellation cause per accepted job; test cancel/save/save/new-step permutations with a controllable scorer.

reworkFamilies.pattern: Mode labels, review IDs and candidate task family were mistaken for evidence identity or semantic correctness.
reworkFamilies.prevention: Bind full rendered visible input, candidate actions, raw review and source episode before import; independently rederive labels and real/fixture class; keep on-policy counterexamples.

reworkFamilies.pattern: Packaged evidence was not bootstrapped at every entry, and process/listener setup or synchronous fake HTTP tests hid actual outcomes.
reworkFamilies.prevention: One evidence bootstrap API shared by npm/eval; register exit listeners at spawn, verify real request markers asynchronously, use unique temp roots and bounded cleanup.

reworkFamilies.pattern: New shared runStep coexisted with old immediate actions and entry-specific advance policies; preserving old tests did not prove the new action lifecycle matched gameplay.
reworkFamilies.prevention: Maintain an explicit profile adapter; test the same timed scenario through CLI/web/fourday and restore. Change lifecycle centrally, not by incrementing time in each transport.

safeSimplificationCandidates.action: Archive/remove unused ScorerServiceClient from current production source after a clean build + joint-service contract checks.
safeSimplificationCandidates.evidence: git grep ScorerServiceClient HEAD outside historical artifacts/handoff/evidence returns only its own definition; current CLI and fourday both import JointScorerClient.
safeSimplificationCandidates.risk: Do not delete historical evidence or replay protocol files. Recheck R9 before removal.

safeSimplificationCandidates.action: Extract the duplicated Gospel game-step/r8-step handler into one function; preserve both command names and legacy profile routing.
safeSimplificationCandidates.evidence: Both current branches call runStep with matching goalBridge, actorIds, expectedGenerations and notes. Only emitted profile and gospel-guard placement differ.
safeSimplificationCandidates.risk: Do not silently map legacy game-step to Gospel; this is precisely the migration reverted at 8d100c4.

safeSimplificationCandidates.action: One callable packaged-evidence bootstrap, with each runner retaining its own reporting.
safeSimplificationCandidates.evidence: npm uses full-file missing-copy restoration; eval uses a single marker and shell bootstrap. Recurrent 54214bd/12cc208/a86c8a1 changes were the same environmental contract.
safeSimplificationCandidates.risk: Preserve existing bytes and SHA failure behavior; never convert historical packaged evidence into a new live model claim.

safeSimplificationCandidates.path: package.json description and public developer docs
safeSimplificationCandidates.action: Present one current product entry and explicit legacy/replay references; keep schema values stable.
safeSimplificationCandidates.evidence: Package description still says G00/G01; current product spans r7 path, R8Runtime class, Gospel profile, v2 session and R4 commitments.
safeSimplificationCandidates.risk: Do not mechanically rename hashed renderer/protocol IDs or saved schemas.

notSafeToDelete: Legacy profile/saved schemas and G00-G11 test fixtures still protect migration and reproducibility.
The authority ledger, cancellation guards and immutable evidence are not defensive clutter; deleting them reopens verified failures.
Summary memory arm is a legacy raw alias; remove it from current experiment choices, but older saves may retain the value.
lineReferenceScope: Historical architectural line ranges refer to baseline 586034f. Use git show 586034f:<path> when current R9 offsets differ.

newEngineerMap.problem: Nine named layers and 4746 lines lie on the immediate web/commitment path before world/model internals; no honest hours estimate can be derived.
stableBoundaries: CLI/HTTP transport owns no simulation time or task semantics.
PlaySession owns world execution and cancellation grants.
R8Runtime owns domain commit/time and deferred work.
CommitmentBoard owns negotiated obligations; task board owns execution work.
ScorePort proposes a bound candidate; authority validates and produces the receipt.
newEngineerMap.renamePolicy: Add current architecture names in docs and explicit adapters first; avoid renaming stored protocol identifiers during the critical round.
